rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: This Google Analytics 4 MCP server provides programmatic access to GA4 data through seven specialized tools including property management, page views, user metrics, events, traffic sources, device analytics, and comprehensive custom reporting via the Google Analytics Data API and Admin API. Built by GoMarble AI, it features automatic OAuth 2.0 authentication with token refresh, eliminating the need for manual credential management while supporting both hierarchical account/property discovery and flexible report generation with custom metrics, dimensions, filtering, and sorting capabilities. The implementation is particularly valuable for marketing analytics, website performance monitoring, and automated reporting workflows where users need seamless access to GA4 insights without complex API integration.
